content_blocks.title: Why this matters
content_blocks.text: Use data separation and metrics that match the task; tuning on test data causes leakage. The example is intentionally small so you can predict its result before checking it in a local R session.

content_blocks.title: Work through it
content_blocks.text: Compare a simple baseline with a held-out estimate and identify one failure mode. Change one input or condition at a time, compare the observed result with your prediction, and write down one limitation.

content_blocks.title: R example: Machine-Learning Evaluation
content_blocks.run_instructions: CodeLeaf does not provide an R runtime. This block is an inspectable reference example; execute it in a local R console or a reviewed R-aware environment. Static validation checks file structure, not R semantics.
content_blocks.reset_steps: No example is executed by this CodeLeaf lesson. For a local run, use synthetic data in a temporary working directory, avoid production credentials or destructive writes, and restart a clean R session to clear lesson objects.
content_blocks.limitations: Use the built-in example only to inspect an lm object; evaluate assumptions and hold-out performance before interpretation. Verify the snippet and expected output with the supported R and package versions before publishing.

content_blocks.title: Common pitfall
content_blocks.text: Do not treat a syntactically plausible example as proof of correctness. For machine-learning evaluation, check the input type, missing/empty cases, output shape, and domain assumptions.

common_mistakes.problem: Treating a p-value, coefficient or score as a complete conclusion.
common_mistakes.why: Study design, assumptions, effect size and uncertainty shape interpretation.
common_mistakes.fix: State the question, inspect diagnostics and report uncertainty and limitations.

common_mistakes.problem: Using test data during feature selection or tuning.
common_mistakes.why: This leaks information and leads to an overly optimistic evaluation.
common_mistakes.fix: Separate training, validation and final test roles before modeling.

common_mistakes.problem: Reporting a model without comparing it with a baseline.
common_mistakes.why: Complexity does not guarantee useful performance.
common_mistakes.fix: Evaluate an appropriate simple baseline with task-relevant metrics.
